The Creation.alt: Blue dawn over a rocky coast, rolling waves and green headlands.

The Fall of Man.alt: A clothed couple leaves a rain-darkened forest along a rocky path.

Cain and Abel.alt: Two brothers stand apart beside grain, sheep and an offering place.

The Line of Seth.alt: An older adult, younger adults and a child cross green farmland.

Noah and the Flood.alt: A family stands near a large wooden ark under clearing storm clouds.

Noahic Covenant.alt: Noah’s family watches a rainbow above rain-washed wetlands.

The Family of Noah.alt: Noah and his family gather grapes beneath a shaded vineyard canopy.

The Tower of Babel.alt: Builders pause beside an unfinished mudbrick tower in a dusty city.

The Call of Abram.alt: Abram’s household travels through rocky highlands before dawn.

Abrahamic Covenant.alt: Abram looks up at a star-filled sky beside a lamplit tent.

Abram and Lot.alt: Abram and Lot choose separate paths above a green valley.

Hagar and Ishmael.alt: Pregnant Hagar rests beside a spring in a shaded red canyon.

Abraham and Sarah’s Covenant.alt: Sarah listens from a shaded tent as Abraham serves three visitors.

Lot Leaves Sodom.alt: Lot and his daughters leave a burning city as a woman turns back.

Isaac and Ishmael.alt: Hagar draws water from a well while Ishmael rests in tree shade.
